params.name: fileName
params.description: Pathname of the file to import; pass an empty string to display the standard Open File dialog box.

params.name: project
params.description: In: XML import project settings (Text/DOM ref) or a legacy BLOB-format project. Out: updated with the new project settings, if * is also passed.
If passed together with project, forces display of the import dialog box pre-seeded with project's settings, letting the user adjust them before import.

overloads.semanticRole: Imports data from fileName using either an interactive dialog (if project is omitted) or a predefined/programmatic import project, optionally letting the user still adjust that project's settings via the dialog.

constraints: The optional * only has an effect when project is also passed; * without project is meaningless since there is then no predefined project to seed the dialog with.
The OK system variable is set to 1 on success and 0 if the user cancels the file/import dialog or the import fails.
